author: Aerafal
name: Palforge server plugin
description: A Palworld dedicated-server plugin: a typed hook, live-game reads, options, and deploy-on-build — referencing Palforge compile-only.

PalforgeVersion.description: The version of the Palforge package to reference.

DeployDirectory.description: A server's Pal\Binaries\Win64. Set it and a build deploys the plugin there; leave it empty and the build simply does not deploy.
